parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value:

*   If this parameter is left empty, the default value is 10.
*   If you set this parameter to a value that is greater than 100, the default value is 100.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token that is used in the request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of `NextToken`.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID pf the diagnostic metric. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type supported by the diagnostic metric.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs describe-diagnostic-metrics --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --metric-ids Instance.DiskLoadFailure --resource-type instance --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --max-results 10 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs DescribeDiagnosticMetrics --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --MetricIds.1 'Instance.DiskLoadFailure' --MaxResults 10 --ResourceType instance --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
